element.reason: COMPONENT-FIXTURES: scroll-area-v1 code unchanged (sha256:7ebbe104bf3e59134a6dc31d0f12590b1769d14ca26a1566eabeabf2f406cac5); adds a preview fixture whose element tree composes the component's own exports with plain sample text, so the Studio card shows a realistic specimen.

props.className: h-40 w-full max-w-sm rounded-md border p-4 text-sm leading-relaxed
children: Release notes. Version 2.4 adds keyboard navigation across every list, faster search across large workspaces, and a new compact density. Version 2.3 introduced shared templates, so a team can start new documents from an approved layout. Version 2.2 brought offline drafts that sync when you reconnect, plus clearer conflict messages when two people edit the same paragraph. Version 2.1 reworked notifications into a single inbox with filters for mentions, replies and assignments.
